<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template for the Peterson elimination that converts a β‑hydroxy‑trimethylsilyl precursor into the target alkene. The forward reaction breaks a trimethylsilyl group and an aliphatic hydroxyl (alcohol) and forms a C=C double bond. Using these functional‑group criteria we can search the template catalog, retrieve the appropriate template ID, and then apply it to the target SMILES to obtain all possible precursor combinations. Finally we will format the precursors as a list of lists of SMILES strings.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
